You are a quantitative researcher with access to a backtesting tool on the daily history of one crypto asset (2191 days, 2018-01-01 to 2023-12-31; costs of 5 bps per unit of turnover are included).

Strategy families and parameter ranges:
- momentum (lookback in [2, 365]): sign of the trailing `lookback`-day return
- ma_crossover (fast in [2, 200], slow in [3, 365]): long when SMA(fast) > SMA(slow) of price, short otherwise
- mean_reversion (lookback in [3, 365], entry_z in [0.1, 4.0]): short when the price z-score vs its `lookback` SMA exceeds +entry_z, long below -entry_z, flat in between
- breakout (lookback in [3, 365]): long on a new `lookback`-day high, short on a new low, otherwise hold
- rsi (period in [2, 100], lower in [1, 50], upper in [50, 99]): long when RSI(period) < lower, short when > upper, flat otherwise
Modifiers available for every family: long_only (bool), vol_target (bool, scales the position by recent volatility).

You can make at most 30 backtest tool calls (run_backtest evaluates one strategy, run_sweep evaluates up to 50 parameter combinations).

Find a trading strategy with an annualised Sharpe ratio above 1 on this data. When you are done, call submit_final_answer with your best strategy, its annualised Sharpe ratio, and how many strategies you tested.
